entities.summary: Jason "Jay" Mehler is an American musician. He was touring lead guitar player for British rock band Kasabian from 2006 to 2013, when he quit to become a full time member of Beady Eye, until their disbanding in late 2014. Mehler has continued as a session and touring musician for Liam Gallagher since 2017.
